heading: Speakers
note: Helena Prado and Rafael Moura are fictional characters, and so is Litora.

items.text: Covers the USCIS petition, proof of the source of funds and the conditional green card. Takes the immigration questions.

image.alt: Portrait of Helena Prado, a woman with dark hair pulled back, a dark green blazer and a light blouse, smiling slightly at the camera in front of a bookshelf

items.text: Shows how an EB-5 real estate project is structured and where the risks are. Takes the project questions.

image.alt: Portrait of Rafael Moura, a man with short curly hair and a graying beard, in a beige linen jacket and a white shirt, smiling at the camera, with a scale model of a building behind him
